messages.content: Hi, saya Mei Ling from platform engineering team Cyberjaya. Saya nak publish satu API baru, `MyPay Wallet Lookup v1`. Workspace `ws-mypay-prod`, slug `mypay-wallet-lookup`, initial version `1.0.0`, OpenAPI 3.1 spec attached on `s3://api-specs/mypay-lookup-v1.yaml`. Boleh start dengan create_api_definition?
Selamat pagi Puan Mei Ling, saya akan mendaftarkan definisi API tersebut dengan versi awal `1.0.0`. Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.name: create_api_definition
function.arguments: {"workspace_id": "ws-mypay-prod", "name": "MyPay Wallet Lookup", "slug": "mypay-wallet-lookup", "description": "Wallet balance and KYC status lookup for MyPay integrations.", "initial_version": {"version_id": "1.0.0", "spec_uri": "s3://api-specs/mypay-lookup-v1.yaml", "spec_format": "openapi_3_1"}, "tags": ["fintech", "wallet", "payments"]}

messages.name: create_api_definition
messages.content: {"api_id": "api-mypay-wallet-lookup", "api_version_id": "ver-1-0-0", "workspace_id": "ws-mypay-prod", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:05:11+08:00", "status": "draft"}
Sebelum buat content bundle, check availability route `/v1/wallet/{walletId}` untuk methods GET dan HEAD. Lepas tu create bundle.
Baik Puan, saya akan semak ketersediaan laluan dan kemudian membina content bundle.

messages.name: check_route_availability
messages.content: {"available": true, "conflicts": []}
Laluan tersedia tanpa konflik. Saya akan teruskan dengan content bundle.

messages.name: create_content_bundle
messages.content: {"content_bundle_id": "bnd-mypay-lookup-001", "workspace_id": "ws-mypay-prod", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:08:02+08:00", "status": "draft"}
Validate bundle dulu, strict mode, semua linting rules on.
Baik Puan, validasi ketat akan dijalankan.

messages.name: validate_content_bundle
messages.content: {"content_bundle_id": "bnd-mypay-lookup-001", "valid": true, "warnings": [{"rule": "openapi_lint", "message": "Missing 4xx examples on /v1/wallet/{walletId}", "severity": "warn"}]}
Bunyi okay. Create change request untuk push ke `staging` dan `prod-my`, judul `MyPay Wallet Lookup v1 GA`, plan deployment sekali.
Baik Puan, saya akan cipta change request dan menjalankan perancangan deployment serentak.

function.name: create_change_request
function.arguments: {"workspace_id": "ws-mypay-prod", "content_bundle_id": "bnd-mypay-lookup-001", "target_environments": ["staging", "prod-my"], "requested_by": "mei.ling@telco.my", "title": "MyPay Wallet Lookup v1 GA", "description": "GA release with rate limit 200 RPS."}

messages.name: create_change_request
messages.content: {"change_request_id": "chg-mypay-1001", "status": "open", "target_environments": ["staging", "prod-my"]}
Saya akan teruskan dengan perancangan deployment.

messages.name: plan_deployment
messages.content: {"deployment_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "plan": {"steps": [{"step": 1, "env": "staging", "phase": "full", "estimated_minutes": 6}, {"step": 2, "env": "prod-my", "phase": "canary_10", "estimated_minutes": 8}, {"step": 3, "env": "prod-my", "phase": "canary_50", "estimated_minutes": 10}, {"step": 4, "env": "prod-my", "phase": "full", "estimated_minutes": 12}]}}
Execute deployment ID `dpl-mypay-1001`. After 10 seconds, get status please.
Baik Puan, saya akan menjalankan deployment dan memantau statusnya.

messages.name: execute_deployment
messages.content: {"deployment_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "status": "running", "started_at": "2026-05-21T09:14:02+08:00"}
Mohon tunggu sebentar. Saya akan semak kemajuan deployment.

messages.name: get_deployment_status
messages.content: {"deployment_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "status": "running", "progress_pct": 35.0, "current_step": {"step": 2, "phase": "canary_10", "env": "prod-my"}}

Sebelum kita commit apa-apa, boleh simulate dulu — saya nak nampak impact kalau kita transition deployment ni ke `in_progress`. Sekali run policy evaluation supaya tahu ada compliance violations ke tidak.
Baik Puan, saya akan jalankan simulasi serta evaluasi polisi serentak untuk mengelakkan kesan tidak diingini.

messages.name: simulate_deployment_changes
messages.content: {"simulation_id": "sim-dpl-mypay-1001-001", "diff": [{"path": "/lifecycle_state", "from": "draft", "to": "in_progress"}], "policy_verdicts": [{"policy_id": "pol-default-safety", "decision": "pass"}], "impact_estimate": {"cpu_cost_delta_pct": 4.1, "blast_radius": {"affected_entities": 3}}, "explain": "Lifecycle change is reversible; no downstream consumers blocked."}

messages.name: evaluate_deployment_policy
messages.content: {"target_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "verdicts": [{"policy_id": "pol-compliance-myr-2026", "decision": "pass", "rules_evaluated": 12}, {"policy_id": "pol-rate-limit-default", "decision": "warn", "violations": [{"rule": "max_concurrent_changes", "current": 4, "limit": 5}]}]}
Tunjuk metrics 24 jam terakhir, dan pull audit history — bos saya nak tahu siapa edit apa sebelum panggilan ni.
Baik Puan, kedua-dua perkara saya tarik serentak.

messages.name: get_deployment_metrics
messages.content: {"metrics": [{"name": "deployment_success_rate", "value": 142}, {"name": "p95_latency_ms", "value": 218.7, "unit": "ms"}, {"name": "error_rate", "value": 0.014}], "time_window": {"from": "2026-05-20T00:00:00+08:00", "to": "2026-05-21T09:30:00+08:00", "timezone": "Asia/Kuala_Lumpur", "granularity": "hour"}}

messages.name: get_deployment_audit_history
messages.content: {"target_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "entries": [{"at": "2026-05-21T08:42:11+08:00", "actor": "system", "action": "auto_assess"}, {"at": "2026-05-21T09:01:22+08:00", "actor": "ops.lead@telco.my", "action": "field_updated", "diff": {"priority": {"from": "normal", "to": "high"}}}, {"at": "2026-05-21T09:14:00+08:00", "actor": "compliance.bot", "action": "policy_evaluated"}], "pagination": {"page": 1, "page_size": 50, "total_count": 3}}
Bagus. Sebelum buat apa-apa drastic, snapshot dulu, tag dia dengan tag audit, dan assign saya sebagai owner.
Baik Puan, saya akan ambil snapshot, tag dan tetapkan pemilik serentak.

messages.name: create_deployment_snapshot
messages.content: {"snapshot_id": "snap-dpl-mypay-1001-001", "created_at": "2026-05-21T09:35:11+08:00", "size_bytes": 18412}

messages.name: tag_deployments
messages.content: {"applied": [{"target_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "tags_count": 2}], "skipped": []}

messages.name: assign_deployment_owner
messages.content: {"target_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "assignments_recorded": 1, "current_owner": "mei.ling@telco.my"}
Encik Ramesh (Director) sudah brief, tolong hantar formal approval request, dan rekod decision dia — dia dah reply approve via email tadi.
Baik Puan, saya akan hantar permohonan kelulusan dan terus rekod keputusan kelulusan secara serentak.

function.name: request_deployment_approval
function.arguments: {"target_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "change_summary": "Apply lifecycle transition to deployment dpl-mypay-1001 after passing simulation and policy checks.", "approvers": [{"stage": 1, "kind": "user", "id": "ramesh.k@telco.my", "min_required": 1}], "urgency": "high"}

messages.name: request_deployment_approval
messages.content: {"approval_request_id": "appr-dpl-mypay-1001-001", "status": "pending", "approvers_notified": ["ramesh.k@telco.my"]}

messages.name: decide_deployment_approval
messages.content: {"approval_request_id": "appr-dpl-mypay-1001-001", "status": "approved", "decided_at": "2026-05-21T09:40:01+08:00"}
Link deployment ni ke ticket induk JIRA `OPS-441`, add satu comment summarising decision, dan upload screenshot approval email dia (pakai presigned URL).
Baik Puan, saya akan link, komen dan muat naik lampiran serentak.

function.name: add_deployment_comment
function.arguments: {"target_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "body": {"format": "markdown", "text": "Director **Ramesh K.** approved via email at 09:40 MYT. Snapshot `snap-dpl-mypay-1001-001` recorded; tags applied; linked to OPS-441."}}

messages.name: link_deployment_to_related
messages.content: {"link_id": "lnk-dpl-mypay-1001-OPS-441", "relation": "related_to"}

messages.name: upload_deployment_attachment
messages.content: {"attachment_id": "att-dpl-mypay-1001-001", "stored_uri": "s3://attach-my/dpl-mypay-1001/ramesh-approval-email.pdf", "size_bytes": 188422}
Sekarang check health dulu — tolong fire satu HTTP probe ke endpoint kami, dan set up retry policy: max 3 attempts, exponential backoff, retry on 5xx.
Baik Puan, saya akan jalankan probe HTTP dan konfigurasikan polisi cuba semula serentak.

messages.name: check_deployment_health
messages.content: {"target_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "probe_results": [{"name": "primary-http", "status": "healthy", "latency_ms": 142, "status_code": 200}], "overall_status": "healthy", "checked_at": "2026-05-21T09:42:18+08:00"}

messages.name: configure_deployment_retry_policy
messages.content: {"policy_id": "rp-dpl-mypay-1001-001", "applied_at": "2026-05-21T09:42:20+08:00", "current": {"max_attempts": 3, "multiplier": 2.0}}
Last thing — boleh banding versi live sekarang dengan snapshot yang baru kita ambil, dan generate satu operational report PDF email ke saya.
Baik Puan, saya akan banding versi serta menjana laporan operasi.

messages.name: compare_deployment_versions
messages.content: {"target_id": "dpl-mypay-1001", "diff_summary": {"changed_fields": 4, "added": 1, "removed": 0}, "diff": [{"path": "/lifecycle_state", "from": "draft", "to": "in_progress"}, {"path": "/owner", "from": null, "to": "mei.ling@telco.my"}, {"path": "/tags", "added": ["audit:maybank-2026"]}]}

messages.content: {"report_id": "rpt-dpl-mypay-1001-ops-001", "format": "pdf", "delivery_status": "queued", "estimated_ready_at": "2026-05-21T09:45:00+08:00"}
Itu sahaja. Bila prod-my dah full rollout, sila ping team channel. Terima kasih banyak.
Sama-sama, Puan Mei Ling. Saya akan memastikan pasukan dimaklumkan apabila rollout penuh ke `prod-my` selesai. Selamat hari.
